turns.prompt_text: I see this place in Ames called munn lumber. I wonder if they have any 12-in pine board lumber boards I saw some at Lowe's down the street but they're about 22.23 for a 12 ft 12 in by 1 in board
turns.response_html:
Munn Lumber (located over on Airport Road) does carry softwood boards ranging from 1x4 up to 1x12. Because they focus heavily on serving professional contractors and custom building projects, they typically stock higher-quality, higher-grade lumber than what you'll find sitting on the shelves at big-box retail stores.

However, because they don't list a live, consumer-facing inventory with exact per-board pricing online, you won't be able to check their real-time 12-foot price or immediate stock levels on a website. Since their yard operates on contractor hours (7:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday through Friday), your best bet is to give them a quick call at (515) 232-2112. You can ask their desk for a quick quote on a 1x12x12 pine board to see how their current yard pricing and wood grade stack up against the $22.23 tag down the road.
